mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_config (config_id, tenant_id, config_key, config_value, description, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{configId}, #{tenantId}, #{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{description}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT config_id, tenant_id, config_key, config_value, description, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_config WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY config_key ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_config WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND config_id = #{configId}
